tools.name: clickElement
tools.description: Click an element on the page. Identify it by a `ref` handle from findElements (preferred) or a CSS `selector`; pass at least one. Errors if neither is given or the element cannot be found.

ref.description: A handle from findElements (e.g. "el-12"). Preferred — pass this when you have one.

selector.description: A CSS selector (e.g. "#add-to-cart"). Use only when you do not have a handle. First match is clicked.

tools.name: describeElement
tools.description: Return detailed information about one element, identified by a `ref` handle from findElements (preferred) or a CSS `selector`; pass at least one. Includes its accessible name and how it was derived, role, all attributes, visibility and interaction state, position, the region it belongs to, its associated label, nearby interactive controls, and a summary of its children. Use this to confirm you have the right element before acting on it.

ref.description: A handle from findElements (e.g. "el-12"). Preferred — pass this when you have one.

selector.description: A CSS selector. Use only when you do not have a handle.

tools.name: fillInput
tools.description: Enter a value into a text input, textarea, or contenteditable element. Identify the element by a `ref` handle from findElements (preferred) or a CSS `selector`; pass at least one. For checkboxes, radios, and buttons use clickElement instead.

ref.description: A handle from findElements (e.g. "el-12"). Preferred — pass this when you have one.

selector.description: A CSS selector. Use only when you do not have a handle.

value.description: The text to enter. An empty string clears the field.

tools.name: findElements
tools.description: Search the current page for elements matching any combination of criteria, and return a ranked list of compact descriptors — each with a `ref` handle you can pass to scrollToElement, highlightElement, or clickElement. Combine criteria to narrow results (e.g. category "input" + text "promo"). Results are visible elements by default, ranked by how well they match — NOT by where they sit on screen. Each result reports whether it is currently in view (state.inViewport); when the element you want is not in view, call scrollToElement with its handle to bring it on-screen before highlighting or clicking. Prefer this over guessing CSS selectors.

attributes.description: Match attributes by substring, e.g. {"placeholder":"code","type":"text"}. An empty value matches presence only.

category.description: High-level element bucket. "clickable" also surfaces heuristically-detected click targets (divs/spans with click affordances).

inViewportOnly.description: Only elements currently in the viewport. Default false.

matchMode.description: How `text` matches. Default "fuzzy" (lexical recall). Use "exact" once you know the literal on-page string.

near.description: A handle (from a prior findElements) — restrict to elements spatially or structurally near it.

offset.description: Skip the first N matches (paging). Default 0.

role.description: ARIA role: button, link, textbox, checkbox, radio, img, heading, etc.

text.description: Free-text match over the element's whole textual surface — accessible name, own text, placeholder, aria-label, alt, title, value, and the associated <label>. Lexical and recall-oriented: case/accent-insensitive, word-order-independent, partial words allowed. Try synonyms across separate calls (e.g. "discount" then "promo"); this does NOT expand synonyms for you.

within.description: A handle, or a landmark/section name (e.g. "Order Summary") — restrict the search to that subtree.

tools.name: getPageContext
tools.description: Return metadata about the current page: url, canonicalUrl, title, meta tags (description, keywords, Open Graph, Twitter Card, etc.), and parsed JSON-LD structured-data blocks. Use this to understand what page the user is on.

tools.name: getPageOutline
tools.description: Return the structural skeleton of the current page: landmark regions (header, nav, main, footer, and labeled sections), the heading outline, the forms present, and a count of interactive elements by category. Use this first to understand how the page is organized before searching for specific elements with findElements. Landmarks and forms include a handle you can pass to findElements' `within` to scope a search.

tools.name: highlightElement
tools.description: Draw the user's attention to an element on the page (a temporary visual emphasis). Identify it by a `ref` handle from findElements (preferred) or a CSS `selector`; pass at least one. Errors if neither is given or the element cannot be found.

ref.description: A handle from findElements (e.g. "el-12"). Preferred — pass this when you have one.

selector.description: A CSS selector (e.g. "#promo-banner"). Use only when you do not have a handle. First match is highlighted.

tools.name: navigateToUrl
tools.description: Navigate the current page to a URL on the same site. Accepts an absolute URL or a path (e.g. "/cart"). Same-origin only — cross-origin navigation is rejected. If the URL already matches the current page, navigation is skipped. Returns the URLs navigated from and to, plus a `navigated` flag (false when skipped, with a `reason` explaining why).

url.description: An absolute same-origin URL (e.g. "https://shop.example.com/cart") or a path (e.g. "/cart").

tools.name: scrollToElement
tools.description: Scroll an element into view. Identify it by a `ref` handle from findElements (preferred) or a CSS `selector`; pass at least one. Use this when a findElements result reports state.inViewport: false, to bring it on-screen before highlighting or clicking. Errors if neither is given or the element cannot be found.

ref.description: A handle from findElements (e.g. "el-12"). Preferred — pass this when you have one.

selector.description: A CSS selector (e.g. "#reviews"). Use only when you do not have a handle. First match is scrolled into view.

tools.name: getProductReviews
tools.description: Get customer reviews for a product from Bazaarvoice. Supports pagination, sorting, filtering by star rating, keyword search, sorting by a product feature, and a photos-only mode. Each review carries title, body, rating, date, recommendation flag, helpfulness votes, and photo URLs.

productId.description: The id of the product. Required

limit.description: Number of reviews to return (default: 5, max: 10). Capped low because BV review payloads are heavy.

offset.description: Number of reviews to skip for pagination (default: 0).

sort.description: Sort order. Ignored when `search` is supplied (Bazaarvoice sorts by relevance during search and returns 0 results if both are sent).

ratingFilter.description: Filter to reviews with this exact star rating (1-5).

search.description: Keyword search within review text (e.g. "shipping", "quality"). Bazaarvoice ranks results by relevance; the `sort` argument is ignored when this is set.

feature.description: Sort reviews by relevance to a named product feature/attribute (e.g. "satisfaction", "quality", "value").

photosOnly.description: When true, returns only reviews that include photos.

tools.name: getReviewSummary
tools.description: Get Bazaarvoice's aggregate review summary for a product. Returns the raw BV summary envelope (average rating, total review count, rating distribution, and bullet-point highlights).

productId.description: The id of the product. Required

tools.name: searchProducts
tools.description: Search adidas.com US catalog via Glass content-engine GET /api/plp/content-engine?sitePath=us&query={q}. Returns compact cards with articleId (productId), title, price, salePrice, rating, image, and PDP link. Empty query returns no results without a network call. Read-only — no cart. Requires Chrome UA + Sec-CH-UA + Origin/Referer (bare UA / Googlebot → Akamai 403). Do NOT call /api/plp/content-engine/search.

tools.name: getProduct
tools.description: Fetch adidas product detail by article number via GET /api/search/product/{articleId}?sitePath=us. Pass articleId (e.g. B75806). Returns title, brand, color, price, orderable, images, and PDP link. Read-only — no cart. Chrome UA + Sec-CH required. Pass the same articleId to bazaarvoice review tools.

tools.name: browseCategory
tools.description: Browse adidas US category grids via the same content-engine endpoint with a taxonomy slug (path after /us/), e.g. men-shoes, women-shoes. Pass categoryId as the slug, or categoryName to map onto known taxonomies. If neither is provided, returns the taxonomy index without a network call. Keyword search should prefer searchProducts.

categoryName.description: Friendly name; case-insensitive contains match when categoryId omitted.

tools.name: searchPolicies
tools.description: Fetch adidas Help pages under /us/help/{topic}/{slug} and return title/summary text from HelpPage __NEXT_DATA__ layouts. Topics map onto proven footer URLs (returns, exchanges, refunds, shipping/delivery, privacy, size charts). Live Help HTML often Akamai 403 — falls back to Wayback then Scout Wayback-validated cache. Never invents policy terms beyond fetched/validated copy. Chrome UA + Sec-CH preferred.

topic.description: Policy topic: returns/exchanges/refunds/shipping/privacy/size charts (or free text with those cues).

_notes.custom: Wired adidas custom bundle — Glass content-engine search/browse + search/product getProduct + Help searchPolicies (Wayback fallback). Bazaarvoice remains common only (clientName adidas, no passkey). No cart/showCheckout. No invented MCP.
_notes.bazaarvoice: clientName adidas from deployments/adidas/main_site/production/en_US (displayCode 28373; api-config client=adidas; conversations=true; askAndAnswer=false; siteAuth=true). Passkey omitted — not published. productId = article number (e.g. B75806). getProductQuestions omitted — askAndAnswer false.
_notes.core: Copied cleaned core from nike.com.beacon-manifest.json — no showCheckout (no checkout config).
